identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current ECOVACS US shop and product pages. WINBOT mini 2 and WINBOT W2S OMNI are window cleaning robots; GOAT O1000 RTK and GOAT GX-600 are robotic lawn mowers. All four are separate current models with their own product pages. No new model was created and no company focus was added; the existing ECOVACS company focus stays unchanged. The reviewed pages publish current shop prices for WINBOT mini 2 (178.60 USD), GOAT O1000 RTK (999.99 USD) and WINBOT W2S OMNI (407.55 USD), so the catalog ~200, 1000 and 600 USD values are replaced; the GOAT GX-600 page shows no price, so the catalog 1,300 USD price is cleared. The catalog size labels are replaced by reviewed dimensions on all four rows, the catalog 1.3 kg, ~10 kg and 20 kg masses by reviewed masses where published and cleared on GOAT GX-600, the catalog ~2 hour, 85 min and 110 min battery labels by reviewed battery capacities where published and cleared on GOAT GX-600, and the catalog 180 min runtime values by reviewed runtime values or cleared where no runtime in minutes is published.

fields.description: The ECOVACS WINBOT W2S OMNI is a station-powered window cleaning robot measuring 270 x 270 x 76 mm and weighing 1.95 +/- 0.1 kg. It carries a 4,500 mAh lithium battery with up to 3 hours charging and 110 +/- 10 minutes cordless runtime, while the station weighs 5.2 +/- 0.2 kg. fields.ipRating: IPX6 mower, station and RTK antenna
fields.description: The ECOVACS GOAT O1000 RTK is a robotic lawn mower measuring 23.62 x 15.75 x 10.35 in and weighing 24.25 lb. It cuts an 8.66 in path at 1.2-3.2 in height, climbs 45% (24 degree) slopes, passes 2.3 ft narrow paths, carries a 4,000 mAh 18 V battery, charges in about 100 min and mows for about 65 min per charge. Noise is 57 dBA, the mower, station and RTK antenna are IPX6 rated, and manufacturer laboratory mowing efficiency is about 1,507-1,938 ft2/h. Travel speed is 1.15 ft/s delicate or 1.64 ft/s efficient. Current price is 999.99 USD. No payload, degrees of freedom, age range or water tank capacity is published; the catalog 1,000 USD price, ~10 kg mass, small size label and ~2 hour battery label are replaced or cleared.

highlights: Consumer range includes DEEBOT floor cleaning, WINBOT glass cleaning and GOAT lawn mowing; ECOVACSCommercial separately describes K1 VAC andM1/M1 3D commercial cleaning platforms.

GOAT A3000 LiDAR PRO, A2000 LiDAR PRO andO1000 LiDAR PRO are separately named hardware models with TruEdge trimming, HoloScope 360 dual-LiDAR and AIVI 3D claims. Garage/blade accessory bundles are not extra robot models.
Commercial tables retain task-specific endurance, roller width, theoretical area rate and clean/recovery tank capacity. K1 charging and area-rate disagreements are exposed rather than averaged.
WINBOT robot mass, portable station battery duration, power-off protection, water tank and area-time rate are separate quantities. Exterior-window use retains the manual tether/weather conditions.
US product prices and stock are dated regional observations. OriginalA3000 out-of-stock status is not inherited byPRO models; model-selector/accessory prices are not substituted for the main product.
Navigation, obstacle avoidance, edge cutting and productivity remain manufacturer claims; no independently verified exclusivity, zero-risk guarantee or complete historical portfolio asserted.
The current US DEEBOT range adds T80 OMNI, X8 PRO OMNI, X9 PRO OMNI and X11 OmniCyclone with OZMO roller mopping, TruEdge edge cleaning and OMNI stations.
The reviewed DEEBOT pages publish 6,400 mAh batteries, 18,000 to 19,500 Pa suction, 4 h 37 min or less charging and 297 min or less silent sweep runtime.
